How should I read these quotations?

  1. The Master said: Is it not a pleasure to learn and to practice what one has learned in due time? Is it not a joy to have friends come from afar? Is it not the mark of a gentleman to remain unresentful when others fail to appreciate one?
    Confucius
    Confucianism
  2. The Master said: The gentleman seeks it in himself; the petty person seeks it in others.
    Confucius
    Confucianism
  3. Heaven moves with vigor; the gentleman accordingly strengthens himself without cease.
    The Book of Changes
    Confucianism
  4. Earth's condition is receptive devotion; the gentleman accordingly thickens his virtue to bear things.
    The Book of Changes
    Confucianism
  5. The Master said: The gentleman seeks harmony but not sameness; the petty man seeks sameness but not harmony.
    Confucius
    Confucianism
